title: Stryd Critical Power Trend by Block
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stryd:run
| search critical_power_w=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(critical_power_w) as avg_critical_power_w by _time training_block
| sort - _time
description: Tracks critical power over time and breaks it out by training block.
value: Critical power by block is a clean read on whether the training cycle is moving the needle.
implementation: Send critical power events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of critical power by training block.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how critical power changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
